corrections.title: Qualify seven existing 3v3 counters following owner-reported 13 November battle losses
corrections.rationale: Owner approved seven complete gameplay definitions in ChatGPT on 13 November 2026 after reviewing an attached gac-battle-feedback schema-1 export. Observed first-attempt losses: JML vs Jabba, Admiral Raddus vs Reva, Baylan/Marrok/Shin vs Grand Moff Tarkin, GAS with substitute 501st clones vs Kelleran Beq, Traya vs Jedi Master Mace Windu, SLKR vs Pirate King Hondo, and JMK vs Lord Vader/Appo/CX-2. The owner cannot recall the Traya third attacker; Fives/Rex were committed to defence, so GAS did not use the recommended trio; Baylan/Marrok/Shin was confirmed. SLKR's opponent used a datacron; Traya's did not; other datacrons/lineups mostly unknown. The seven approved changes are exactly three tier downgrades (JML S to C, Raddus A to B, Baylan S to A), two substitutions to existing exact-trio counter identities (Baylan and GAS) and seven concise reliability notes. Scores and undersize remain unchanged. These are owner-approved planning judgments, not measured clear averages or current-season universal success rates.

evidence.supports: Defines export of local battle outcomes, revisions, attempt/datacron/notes fields and privacy-minimised evidence; it does NOT contain the owner's private 13 November battle results.
Source baseline for the seven existing defence counter rows, with existing tier/banner/undersize and optional notes. Source is an authoring baseline, not independent proof of effectiveness.
Provides historical 3v3 counter context for the prior research review; specific November 2026 exact-lineup win rates have not been revalidated here and are not claimed.

provenance.conditions: All changes are 3v3 only. Current generic 3v3 defence identities are retained, including Lord Vader whose canonical reference is Appo/Scorch, while the owner faced Appo/CX-2. The observed 13 November results are first-party owner testimony from a locally attached JSON export, not a public GitHub issue artifact. Exact defending and attacking supporting teams are partly unknown. A counter-ID substitution changes required-unit eligibility and resource allocation through existing application logic. No datacron absence should be inferred from unknown values.
provenance.confidence: Medium: owner observed exact attacker/defence leaders and outcomes, with precise Baylan trio, GAS substitution and Lord Vader variant additionally confirmed; older public matchup context is variant-sensitive. Low for unrecorded supporting characters, missing banners and most datacrons. Judgement-based tiers are owner-approved, not independently estimated probabilities.
provenance.limitations: No raw private feedback export uploaded to GitHub. External exact-match statistics from prior chat were not independently revalidated in the present proposal; the historical source is not proof of any particular November event. Traya's third attacker unremembered; GAS improvised lineup should not downgrade the GAS/Fives/Rex trio; Raddus third attacker unknown; SLKR's opposing datacron effect unknown. JML bannerScore 48 and all other bannerScores remain planning values, not losing-battle banners. Existing generic TRAYA, SLKR and JMK counter definitions do not enforce the exact teams recommended in notes. Other defence variants and all unrelated rows remain out of scope.
